description: Defines the BasketItemViewModel class in the web application's basket page, representing individual items in the shopping basket.

classes.name: BasketItemViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class for representing an item in the shopping basket, including product details and quantity.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Gets or sets the unique identifier for the basket item.

methods.name: CatalogItemId
methods.description: Gets or sets the identifier of the catalog item associated with this basket item.

methods.name: ProductName
methods.description: Gets or sets the name of the product.

methods.name: UnitPrice
methods.description: Gets or sets the current unit price of the product.

methods.name: OldUnitPrice
methods.description: Gets or sets the previous unit price, possibly for display purposes.

methods.name: Quantity
methods.description: Gets or sets the quantity of the product in the basket; validated to be non-negative.

methods.name: PictureUrl
methods.description: Gets or sets the URL of the product image.
